name: How should I compare remodeling contractors for an older home?

mainEntity.name: How should I compare remodeling contractors for an older home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Do not choose a contractor solely on the lowest initial number; compare the scope, assumptions, experience with older homes, communication process, and handling of concealed conditions. Context: Elite Remodeling & Design combines design development, construction coordination, and permitting support for projects from rooms to whole-home renovations. Key factors: who prepares the design, who manages subcontractors, what the estimate excludes, how changes are priced, and how inspections are coordinated. Practical guidance: request comparable written scopes and ask each contractor how they document existing conditions and discoveries. Verify licensing and references independently. The best comparison is between equivalent deliverables, not headline prices.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare equivalent written scopes, design responsibility, permit handling, allowances, exclusions, change-order rules, schedule assumptions, and experience with concealed conditions. Verify licensing and references, and ask how discoveries behind walls or under floors will be documented and priced.
